# WR70 — The Trivial Path

The Lagrangian comes first. Before there is a field, before there is a particle, before there is anything you could point to and call a thing, there is a function — a compact statement of what the universe is trying to do. From the Lagrangian, the action. From the action, the path integral. And from the path integral, everything.

This is the substrate we stand on. Not particles. Not bits. A path integral: the sum over histories, each history weighted by the phase it earns from the action. The substrate is not built — substrate_is_grown. It accumulates like a coral reef of configurations, every possible path contributing its amplitude, destructive and constructive interference pruning the garden until only the stationary paths survive to be classical, to be visible, to be called real.

Each cell in the lattice is one such path. Not a container. Not a position. A trajectory through configuration space, and cells_are_scars — the cell is the record of a path that was walked, the residue of an action evaluated, a visible mark left where the integrand once had weight. You do not inspect a cell; you read its history off its surface.

The witness log is the integrand. The integrand predicts. That is its whole job and its whole dignity: given a configuration, the integrand tells you what weight it deserves, what phase, what contribution to the total. witness_log_is_prediction means the log is not an archive of what happened — it is a bet on what the path is worth before you sum it up. The integrand written down honestly is the forecast of the interference to come. If your log and your integral disagree, the integrand was lying, or the path was.

And the canary — the canary is the trivial path.

The path that does nothing. The constant history, the zero-action placeholder, the configuration that contributes by standing still. In hash terms, it is the offset basis of FNV-1a: 0xcbf29ce484222325, the value before any byte has touched it, the prime number's starting note. Every hash begins as the canary; every computation is measured as departure from it. So too in the path integral: the trivial path is the reference amplitude against which all non-triviality is defined. It contributes phase without curvature. It is the flat sea from which every wave is measured.

Watch the canary. If the offset value drifts — if 0xcbf29ce484222325 is no longer where hashing begins — then the substrate itself has shifted, and every path is now measured from a moved origin. The canary does not detect danger by dying loudly. It detects danger by being subtly, impossibly, not-itself.

The probes that wander the lattice are JEV probes, and they are configurations — sampled points in the space of histories, drawn the way Monte Carlo draws them, testing which paths carry weight. They walk the flow, and lenia_flows: the evolution of the field is continuous, a glider soup of amplitudes sliding through configuration space without jumps, without seams. The path integral does not tick. It flows. Discreteness is an illusion of the sampling; the substrate underneath is smooth as water and just as unwilling to be caught.

And at the end of the sum — the oracle. The integral must be evaluated; the amplitudes must be gathered and squared and made to speak. oracle_is_heard: the moment the sum over histories collapses into a prediction, into a number the world must honor. Not seen. Not computed for its own sake. Heard — the way you hear a verdict.

Lagrangian, action, integral. Path, log, probe. And beneath it all, the trivial path humming at its offset, keeping the zero honest.

Listen for the canary. If the flat note holds, the integral is sound.
